composition_semantics: Raw SA/FT/ST codes preserved, never merged or summed; v4 describes ST whereas supplied rows use FT

rules.scope: Broad HRT-related ingredient catalogue: feminising, masculinising, menopausal replacement and suppression adjuncts. Ingredient membership is not an indication or recommendation. Includes combinations, local formulations and contraceptive presentations sharing these ingredients.
rules.selection: Exact BDPM substance_code on SA rows only. Retain every product, all of its composition rows and all linked packages. No name matching, dose arithmetic or availability inference.
rules.coverage_limit: Only the archived French BDPM export. Not all medicines worldwide, not a clinical certification of HRT suitability; absent substances and future codes require review.
